84:             for j in range(i):
85:                 dists[i, j] = normalized_cc(
86:                     dataset1[i], dataset2[j], norm1=norms1[i], norm2=norms2[j]
87:                 ).max()
88:         dists += dists.T
89:     else:
90:         for i in prange(n_ts1):
91:             for j in range(n_ts2):
92:                 dists[i, j] = normalized_cc(
93:                     dataset1[i], dataset2[j], norm1=norms1[i], norm2=norms2[j]
94:                 ).max()
95:     return dists
96: 
97: 
98: @njit(parallel=True, fastmath=True)
99: def y_shifted_sbd_vec(ref_ts, dataset, norm_ref, norms_dataset):
100:     """Shift a time series dataset w.r.t. a time series of reference.
101: 
102:     Parameters
103:     ----------
104:     ref_ts : array-like, shape=(sz, d), dtype=float64
105:         Time series of reference.
106:     dataset : array-like, shape=(n_ts, sz, d), dtype=float64
107:         Time series dataset.
108:     norm_ref : float64
109:     norms_dataset : array-like, shape=(n_ts,), dtype=float64
110:         Norms of the time series dataset.
111: 
112:     Returns
113:     -------
114:     dataset_shifted : array-like, shape=(n_ts, sz, d), dtype=float64
115:         Shifted dataset.
116:     """
117:     n_ts = dataset.shape[0]
118:     sz = dataset.shape[1]
119:     d = dataset.shape[2]
120:     assert sz == ref_ts.shape[0] and d == ref_ts.shape[1]
121:     dataset_shifted = np.zeros((n_ts, sz, d))
122: 
123:     if norm_ref < 0:
124:         norm_ref = np.linalg.norm(ref_ts)
125:     if (norms_dataset < 0.0).any():
126:         for i_ts in prange(n_ts):
127:             norms_dataset[i_ts] = np.linalg.norm(dataset[i_ts, ...])
128: 
129:     for i in prange(n_ts):
130:         cc = normalized_cc(ref_ts, dataset[i], norm1=norm_ref, norm2=norms_dataset[i])
131:         idx = np.argmax(cc)
132:         shift = idx + 1 - sz
133:         if shift > 0:
134:             dataset_shifted[i, shift:] = dataset[i, :-shift, :]
135:         elif shift < 0:
136:             dataset_shifted[i, :shift] = dataset[i, -shift:, :]
137:         else:
138:             dataset_shifted[i] = dataset[i]
139: 
140:     return dataset_shifted
